local stats = {}

function stats.sum(values)
  local total = 0
  for _, value in ipairs(values) do
    total = total + value
  end
  return total
end

function stats.average(values)
  if #values == 0 then return 0 end
  return stats.sum(values) / #values
end

return stats
files.main.lua:
local config = require("lib.config")
local format = require("lib.format")
local stats = require("lib.math.stats")

-- Requiring the same module twice should return the cached value and execute it once.
local firstProbe = require("lib.require_probe")
local secondProbe = require("lib.require_probe")
assert(firstProbe == secondProbe, "require cache did not return the same module")
assert(firstProbe.loads == 1, "module executed more than once")

-- Type a name on the first line, then any number of notes below it.
local name = io.read("*l") or "anonymous"
local notes = io.read("*a") or ""

local values = { 4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42 }
local total = stats.sum(values)
local average = stats.average(values)

print(format.heading(config.appName))
print("runtime:", _VERSION)
print("hello:", format.quote(name))
print("module cache loads:", firstProbe.loads)
print("numbers:", table.concat(values, ", "))
print("sum:", total)
print("average x multiplier:", average * config.multiplier)

if notes ~= "" then
  print("notes:")
  print(notes)
else
  print("notes: (none supplied)")
end

print("Capability tour finished successfully.")
